scope: Eight death-cause forms and the dissolving residue for the nine rounded runtime bodies: accepted standard dead faces (N068/N044/N027/N045/N026/N069/N060/N070) on each body atlas, skin/hair/accessory recolouring, cylindrical skin overlays and two ground decals, plus a faded sleep-face atlas for unripe fruit kept on a dead mother stem. House and rare forms keep the sleep face with the same pose and overlays. Deibu bodies use the ordinary reimu dead faces without the mature-face treatment. No user visual acceptance yet.
